title: Qual baseline v1
description: Known-diagnostic fingerprints (DESIGN 8.3). A fingerprint never contains line numbers: it is rule ID + relative path + qualified Scene name + surrounding token hash, so inserting unrelated lines elsewhere in a file does not invalidate entries. Entries are sorted and each entry hides at most one matching diagnostic. Provenance: files written with scene attribution carry scene_attribution: "attributed" — their empty scene means literally outside any Scene class and matches exactly. Files without the marker are legacy pre-attribution baselines (they stored "" everywhere), and only there does an empty stored scene match a diagnostic regardless of its computed scene (wildcard). A non-empty scene always matches only that scene. The marker is additive, so schema_version stays 1: legacy documents remain valid and entry shapes are unchanged.

scene_attribution.description: Provenance marker, always written by attributing builds. Present: entries were computed with scene attribution and an empty scene matches exactly (outside any Scene). Absent: legacy pre-attribution baseline whose empty scenes match as wildcards.

path.description: Project-relative POSIX path of the diagnosed file

scene.description: Qualified name of the discovered Scene class enclosing the diagnostic, or "" outside every Scene. Only in a legacy file without the scene_attribution marker does a stored "" additionally match any computed scene (wildcard)

token_hash.description: FNV-1a 64-bit hash of the token kinds and texts of the diagnostic statement line and its nearest non-blank neighbor lines
